content:
**Bullet Storm** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *CAMP Revamp* update.

Enables "Bullet Storm" stacks. Spending ammo increases stacks. All stacks are lost when you reload or change weapons. The count of ammo spent carries over between reloads. Weapons that fire multiple projectiles grant bonus ammo spent.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Gain 9% damage per 30 ammo spent. 10 max stacks. | 0031AF16 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Gain 6% damage per 30 ammo spent. 10 max stacks. | 0031AF15 | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain 3% damage per 30 ammo spent. 10 max stacks. | 0031AF14 |
